_doc: Products the paid steps of the expansion round (X1-X5: web search, Google Shopping, visual search) are not spent on (catalog_match.expand.scope_gate, setting EXPANSION_SCOPE_GATE). The free X0 page recovery still runs. Each entry names a kind of product no store lists as a front packshot of one pack: a florist's bouquet is photographed as an arrangement, and its 'brand' is the shop that made it. A product name (or Arabic name) is out of scope when one of its whole words (catalog_match.text_norm.tokens, so Arabic is normalised: 'باقة' is 'باقه') is in 'words' and none is in 'unless': rose water, rose syrup, flower honey and flower tea are groceries and keep the round. Only plural flower words are listed: a singular 'rose' or 'flower' is often a flavour. Live runs 2026-10-05: five bouquet rows spent 15 paid calls and got no pick.
